acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a steam shower, especially as part of a larger renovation, typically requires electrical, plumbing, and potentially building permits to ensure compliance with local codes. In the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, AKN Design Group manages all necessary permit coordination for our clients. Our managed process includes handling these critical details to ensure your project meets all regulatory requirements and structural safety standards.
